headline: Hand lanes get their own door: MANUAL-LANE ships
lede: Anything Jon starts in a fresh folder — Inkling, Gemini, a Claude session, his own hands — can now follow one page and ship to this site like any lane does. The forge learned to stay off those issues: the warden, the planner and the QA ladder all skip work labeled lane:manual, and the board shows it in its own column.

notes.text: #3093 shipped as PR #3097 (merge 38c21fb): docs/MANUAL-LANE.md with every command verified against the live scripts — including the fix that claiming a queued issue needs lane:manual WITH building, or the corpse ladder hands it to an idle builder.

Enforcement is code, not vibes: lib/lanes.mjs keeps lane:manual out of every ladder and QA queue count, idle.mjs refuses to score manual-owned feedback as weakness, and the pulse line now carries manual=N. lanecheck grew two sections (183 gates) with a mutant proof on the load-bearing filter.
Slot a kept building while this ran: #3101 put Mario's attract button back in the clear band above the pad zone, and #3094 (STOMPTOWN) is mid-build.
